name: Iori
message: 「Zzz... mmm...」

name: Iori
message: 「Hau-wha！？」
Hearing the sound of a bugle, my consciousness snapped awake in an instant.
I jumped up, reached for my uniform... and then realized.

name: Iori
message: 「...Ah, this isn't the barracks, is it？」
Right, I'm currently on an “errand”...
It's 6:00 AM.
I’d left my alarm set to the one I’m used to, so I woke up with more clarity than I’d ever want.

name: Iori
message: 「...Maybe I should change my alarm.」
This is a room in the academy’s staff dormitory. It’s a room the academy provided for me since I’m on assignment here.
The staff dormitory is built right next to the students' dorms and connected by a hallway. I can rush over anytime if something happens.
After finishing my morning routine and leaving my room, it was already 6:30.

name: Iori
message: 「It really is an impressive building.」
I thought so when I was a student here too, but all the facilities at Murakumo Academy are luxurious. Just looking at the dorm, it’s better built than your average hotel.

name: Iori
message: 「As expected of the Suzakuin... or rather, I wonder if this is thanks to the Kazamine？」
Murakumo Academy was only able to gather these well-equipped facilities because of the full backing of the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association.
Keisetsu did say that the Kazamine were the ones supporting the finances, didn't she?

name: Iori
message: 「Phew, my stomach feels heavy...」
There’s a small cafeteria for staff on the first floor of the dormitory, and residents can eat as much of any dish as they want for free.
The food was so delicious that I ended up eating a bit too much first thing in the morning.

name: Iori
message: 「Murakumo Academy is great. I’d love to get a permanent job here if I could.」
I’ve spent several years living in barracks without any major complaints, but once I get used to living here, going back seems tough.

name: Iori
message: 「...Wait, hmm？」
A notification came in from an app.
When I pulled up the holographic display, I saw a character modeled after a cat hiding in the shadows of some grass.

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, I’ve never seen that one before！？」
The app I opened was 『Pochett Monster GO』.
<d0060>Pochemon</d> utilize HR, so monsters appear all over town as if they actually exist in reality.
Players catch and train Pochemon, then make them fight in battles.

name: Iori
message: 「Ooh, I want to catch it！」
I am on duty, but it’s before work starts, so just a little bit should be fine...！
I slowly inch closer to the Pochemon.

name: Iori
message: 「Ah... G-Good morning, Setsugekka！」
Setsugekka shows up right as I'm poised to catch it.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-What are you doing？」

name: Iori
message: 「Uh, well, I was just thinking of catching a cat.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh, a cat？ What are you going to do once you catch it？」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm gonna raise it and use it in battle.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「U-Use a cat in battle？！ Sensei, you're a total monster！」

name: Iori
message: 「N-No, that's not what I meant！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No, no~ No need to explain. If you'll excuse me!」
Whoa, I totally creeped her out...

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, wait up. Where are you going？」
I stop Setsugekka as she starts heading off in a different direction from the classroom.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Um, I was thinking of grabbing some food at the convenience store.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm, I can't say I'm a fan of that. Your diet's going to be unbalanced.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-Well, that's true, but~...」
The academy has a cafeteria with a system where, if a student requests it, a nutritionist will help them maintain a balanced diet.
Students in the Martial Arts Division, in particular, are actively encouraged to make use of this system.
Well, back when I was a student here, I used to go out buying snacks all the time myself.
Telling academy students who are still growing in both mind and body not to snack is just way too cruel.

name: Iori
message: 「Oh well, guess it's fine. Let's go together, then.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whaaaat？！」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, what's that for? You don't have to be so against it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「B-Because... it's embarrassing.」

name: Iori
message: 「What is？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Come on, you saw it, didn't you?！ My... you-know-what！」
Talking about the masturbation I saw on the first day?

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, you’re remembering it right now！ Stop it, it’s embarrassing, don't humiliate me any further~！」

name: Iori
message: 「I get it, I won’t think about it anymore！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Are you sure？ Even looking at this face？」

name: Iori
message: 「……I won’t think about it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, there was a pause just now！ I hate this so muuuuch！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Alright, let’s erase Mr. Muragaki’s memory！」

name: Iori
message: 「How？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm, I wonder if there’s a memory-erasing beam or something.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「And then I’ll blast Mr. Muragaki to death.」

name: Iori
message: 「If you kill me, wouldn't erasing the memory be irrelevant...？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Noooo, I still want you to erase it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Because if you were to reincarnate in another world, you’d be taking my embarrassing memories to that world, wouldn't you?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I absolutely forbid that！ The contaminated memory must be scrubbed clean~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I want to be a pure, innocent maiden in Mr. Muragaki’s mind！」
……She really is a strange girl.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So, you’re really coming with me.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I just thought I should check what you’re buying.」
If she ends up buying something with way too many calories, I should probably warn her about it.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Does that mean you’re interested in what kind of feminine hygiene products I use...？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, you said you were going to buy food just a second ago, didn’t you！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Th-that’s true, but...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It’s just that, how should I put it, Mr. Muragaki and I have this kind of... horny-for-each-other type of relationship.」

name: Iori
message: 「I’d appreciate it if you stopped being lustful toward me.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「N-no, that’s not the nuance I meant!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Like, I kind of want to wrap Muragaki-sensei around my little finger with my own alluring charm, you know！」

name: Iori
message: 「You realize that by saying that out loud, you’ve pretty much ruined any chance of that happening, right？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahhh—！？ Damn it, I’m such an idiot, such an idiot！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ughhh, why do I have to be such a ditz……」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「*Sigh*, I wish I had a cool, intellectual aura like Kei-chan and a silent, beast-like demeanor like Nakamura Sakura.」

name: Iori
message: 「Does a person like that even exist in this world……？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「They do! And if they don't, I’ll just have to become one myself!」
「Watch it……」
Setsugekka was passionately laying out her theory, but she ended up bumping into a student who was just walking out of the convenience store.
「Hey…… watch where you’re going, will you?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So-so-sorry！」
「Tch…… be more careful.」
The girl, who was radiating a dangerous aura, didn't bother engaging any further and walked off in the opposite direction of the academy.

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, Setsugekka. You alright？」
Setsugekka was frozen in place.
She was a girl with a very intense vibe, so she must have been too shocked to move.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「……Good.」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It’s good…… it’s actually really good！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You saw her too, right, Sensei? That dangerous, dark, shadowy aura！ The way she spoke, like a knife that cuts through everything it touches！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s it! That’s exactly what I’m looking for! That person is my ideal!」

name: Iori
message: 「Y-your ideal？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Exactly! My vision for the future, you know, my role model？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, right, her name! I have to go ask for her name!」
No sooner had she said that than Setsugekka dashed off.

name: Iori
message: 「Wait, what about the convenience store！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sooorryyyyy!」
Along with Setsugekka, I chase after the threatening girl from before.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You there! Please, just a moment of your time!」
The girl who was called out to turns around lethargically.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Um, excuse me！ May I have your name？」
「Why the hell should I tell you my name?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Because you’re so cool！！！」
「H, hah? What the hell are you talking about?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I beg of you, I’m begging you, just your name, please～」
Setsugekka edges closer, her hands wriggling with excitement.
「G, gross... fine, just don’t come any closer.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「...I’m Arakawa Sonomi.」
I launch my HR in private mode so no one around can see, and check the profile registered with the academy.
Arakawa Sonomi, second-year in the Martial Arts Division. As a first-year, she already cleared the Martial Festival qualifiers, but was defeated in the first round of the main tournament.
She tends to skip class and her conduct isn't great, but it seems she is one of the top fighters among the second-year Martial Arts students.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「S, Sonomi-san... Sono-chan？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hey, are you my friend or something？ Don't go calling me so familiarly.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Aaaah, that cool gaze like you’re looking at trash, and that rough tone... truly the distant <d0036>Arcadia</d> I aim for...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Hey you, the guy there. Do you know this person?」

name: Iori
message: 「Know her? She’s a student in my class.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Tch... you’re a teach, huh.」
Sonomi glares at me with intense hostility in her eyes. It seems she really doesn't like teachers.

name: Iori
message: 「The academy isn't in that direction, though. Where are you going？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Wherever I’m going or whatever I’m doing, it’s got nothing to do with you.」

name: Iori
message: 「It may not have anything to do with me, but I can’t just leave you be.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Tch, this is exactly why teachers are such a pain...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Um, Sono-chan?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Cut it out, don't call me Sono-chan！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then what should I call you...?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「You're a first-year, right？ That makes me your upperclassman. At the very least, show some respect to your seniors.」
I don’t think you use respectful language with your seniors either, though...

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm, how about Sono-chan-senpai？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Seriously, you... whatever, fine, call me whatever you want.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「So? What do you want with me?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I really look up to people like you, Sono-chan-senpai!」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Huh? Do you even know who I am?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No, I just found out about you earlier.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Do you want me to clobber you？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「To be exact, I actually look up to Nakamura Sakura.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You have such a similar vibe to Nakamura Sakura, Sono-chan-senpai, I fell for you the moment I saw you！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Oh, so you're a fan of Nakamura Sakura?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes! Does that mean you like her too, Nakamura Sakura?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「...I guess you could say that.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoaaaaa！！ Seriously?！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「To think we’d even share the same taste in idols—this meeting must be destiny！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「That’s some cheap-ass destiny.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A <d0044>cool beauty</d> who likes Nakamura Sakura and carries herself with a rebellious edge—to me, your very existence is perfect！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Quit saying such embarrassing crap...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「In that case, I’m following you wherever you go, Sono-chan-senpai！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Ugh, stop following me, you're annoying.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eeeeh—, no way！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But Sonomi-senpai and I are comrades bound together by our love for Nakamura Sakura-senshu, aren't we?！」
To Setsugekka, who admires heels, it seems Arakawa Sonomi is an incredibly captivating existence.

name: Iori
message: 「Well, it's not a bad thing to admire someone.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Right?！」

name: Iori
message: 「But Setsugekka, you have class coming up, don't you？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sensei... today, I met my spiritual mentor.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If I had to choose between a mentor and a teacher, I think the mentor is more important.」

name: Iori
message: 「Wait, really？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So today, I intend to learn all sorts of things from this mentor of mine!」
Setsugekka hides behind Arakawa Sonomi.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hey, don't tell me... who exactly is this 'mentor' you're talking about？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It's obviously you, Sonomi-senpai. Right, Master？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Are you an idiot? Don't ask me to agree with you!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A-and, when I'm with Muragaki-sensei, all those traumatic memories come flooding back, making my heart thump and race!」

name: Iori
message: 「Does it really make you that excited?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It’s just that I think I need a bit more time before we can interact...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm sorry! So, today, I'm going to go with my mentor!」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I told you not to follow me！ And I'm not your mentor！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Good grief, this is ridiculous. I'm done with this!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, wait for me, Master~！」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey... where are you going, Setsugekka!」
Not that I even had a chance to stop her. Setsugekka stuck herself to Sonomi’s heels and headed off somewhere.
That girl... I hope she actually makes it back in time for class...
